subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public `before_tool_call` policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose, and which provenance/session facts are safe for ordinary plugins versus trusted policy plugins?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines a public Plugin SDK security-policy surface and a plugin-visible provenance boundary that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Define Unified Policy Facts
options.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it across hook dispatch, trusted policies, docs, API baselines, and tests.

options.title: Land Narrow Provenance Slices First
options.body: Accept narrower work such as external-content provenance while keeping this issue open for the broader action and input provenance design.

options.title: Defer Hook Enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape until capability descriptors, Security Matrix facts, and provenance visibility are settled together.

recommendation.title: Define Unified Policy Facts
recommendation.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it across hook dispatch, trusted policies, docs, API baselines, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their generic host-hook contract work is the closest existing SDK seam for public trusted-policy and `before_tool_call` facts decisions.
